After 16 consecutive years as Hungary’s prime minister, Viktor Orbán lost his re-election campaign. I spoke with historian @TimothyDSnyder about what this defeat of someone who has been a model for far-right movements around the world means for the MAGA movement and the future of liberal democracy.

About six in 10 Americans disapprove of President Trump’s handling of the Iran war, while the president’s own approval ratings have hit their lowest point in his second term.

Will President Trump change course?

My conversation with @nytimes chief political analyst @Nate_Cohn:

The Iran war has triggered one of the biggest supply shocks in the oil market’s history.

Why, then, does Wall Street appear so unfazed?

President Trump’s abuse of America's allies has reached a tipping point.

Now countries have started making long-term policy shifts — and those shifts will soon take on a life of their own.

My take:

Video

Has the US president become more like a king? That’s exactly what the Founders feared, but executive power has grown steadily since the 1950s. Tune in to @CNN tonight at 8pm ET/PT for my latest hour-long special report, “The Imperial Presidency”

On GPS, at 10am & 1pm ET today on @CNN: I’ll talk w/ presidential historian @TimNaftali about last night’s shooting outside the White House Correspondents’ Dinner; retired US Navy Adm. William McRaven about the standoff in the Strait of Hormuz & his new book, "Duty, Honor, Country & Life: A Tribute to the American Spirit”; and @scmallaby, author of “The Infinity Machine,” about the risks of powerful AI

Tune in Sunday night @ 8pm ET/PT for my latest hour-long @CNN special, “The Imperial Presidency” 

From DOGE’s budget-slashing to his attempt to end birthright citizenship, Pres. Trump has waved his presidential pen like a magic wand to usher in major policy changes without Congress weighing in

It’s unprecedented, but it’s also part of a longer political history of US presidents granting themselves more and more authority over the years & decades

I’ll examine that history & share my own though

On GPS, at 10am & 1pm ET Sunday on @CNN …
• Sizing up the most dramatic naval standoff in recent history. I’ll talk strategy & tactics in the Strait of Hormuz w/ retired US Navy Adm. William McRaven—who also discusses his new book, "Duty, Honor, Country & Life: A Tribute to the American Spirit”
• While Ukraine earns plaudits for its drone strategy, Kateryna Bondar of @CSIS tells me Russia has made strides w/ autonomous drones that can strike without human control. As AI reaches the battlefield,
